facts.title: shader.gallery — backgrounds that glow in the dark
facts.description: 201 WebGL background shaders that move like light: dark, alive, and re-themeable across 30 palettes in real time. MIT, no build step, no dependencies.

research.name: shader.gallery
research.note: MIT collection of 201 dark, glowing WebGL background shaders that recolour live across 30 palettes, with web component and framework wrappers.

effects: 201 fragment-shader backgrounds in 33 families (Molten, Aura, Moire, Filament, Glitch, Veil and others)
Live re-theming of every shader across 30 palettes without reload
Evolve mode that breeds shader parameters and Mashup that blends two shaders
Shared post-FX pass with film grain, chromatic aberration and vignette

unverified: The shader source is in the public repository shader-gallery/shaders (MIT, 0 stars), with the runtime in shader-gallery/runtime; this site research has not yet been redone as a repository research of shader-gallery/shaders.
Evolve and Mashup were not opened; they are described on the home, about and FAQ pages.
